title: Edit_Result.id field comment only mentions draw, but demolish now populates it too
detail: Field now also returns the demolished entity id (topology_apply_edit returns {ok=true, id=c.pipe}/{id=c.node}). The proc-level doc was updated; this field comment was not.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to `// the new pipe id on a draw, or the demolished entity id on a demolish` to match topology_apply_edit's doc.
